proposed.citation: Achim Zeileis and Thomas Lumley (2026), \({\tt sandwich}\) version 3.1-3 source package, CRAN, published August 3, 2026, especially \({\tt R/bread.R}\).

proposed_core_edits.reason: The clubSandwich default sandwich assembly calls sandwich::bread, so the exact lm bread scaling requires its own versioned source record.

proposed.statement: Suppose \(G_{1n}\ge 2\) and \(G_{0n}\ge 2\). Let \({\tt fit}={\tt lm}(Y^{\mathrm{obs}}\sim Z)\) be unweighted, with only an intercept and numeric binary group treatment, equal group size \(M\), and clusters equal the realized groups. With the default identity target, the treatment-coordinate entry of \({\tt clubSandwich::vcovCR}({\tt fit},\ {\tt cluster}={\tt group},\ {\tt type}={\tt 'CR2'})\) equals \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{CR2},n}=s_{1,n}^2/G_{1n}+s_{0,n}^2/G_{0n}\) exactly.
proposed.justification: Freezing the exact software call prevents a theoretical group-HC2 formula from being misapplied to a different sandwich specification.
proposed.gap: FuSamiiWang2026 states the equal-group formula and an implementation call, but it does not connect that software output to the dense projection correction.
proposed.consumer: The proposition identifies the exact coefficient variance returned to users of \({\tt clubSandwich}\) in the design studied here.

proposed_core_edits.reason: Declare the versioned clubSandwich CR2 assembly and sandwich lm bread contracts as load-bearing cited dependencies of the exact software identity.
